name: Zircon Gamma
rootCause: Zircon Gamma, an AMM protocol operating on BNB Chain and Moonriver, was exploited on March 18, 2023 due to a vulnerability in its modified Uniswap V2 core. The incident drained approximately $350,000 from user funds by manipulating share accounting via the burnOneSide function. A share accounting vulnerability in the burnOneSide function allowed an attacker to drain all pools on both chains. The function failed to correctly account for single-sided burns, enabling the attacker to manipulate shares and withdraw excess funds.
